notes.title: 🌿 Robert the Plant – A Special Throwback!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147493/73c52c42c0b8cdd5e4d62848df5805e2a91b04d6.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Today, we’re taking a moment to shine a spotlight on a wonderful throwback! About five months ago, one of our community members played [i]Nocturnal Nemesis[/i] and shared their hilarious and suspenseful experience — featuring none other than "Robert the Plant!" 🌱

In their playthrough, they bravely monitored the old winery, navigated the eerie corridors, and even made a new leafy friend along the way.
It's always incredible to see the creative and fun ways players experience our world, and we couldn’t be more grateful. 💛

If you’d like to relive their adventure or catch it for the first time, be sure to check it out:
🎥[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x7VzDWd0U20] Meet Robert the Plant! | Nocturnal Nemesis Gameplay[/url]

And as always — thank you all for your continued support.
Stay safe out there... and maybe say hi to Robert for us! 👀🌿

P.S. We also have our [url=https://discord.com/invite/HXbZdCxugh]Discord server[/url] if you want to see how CLOSE we are to releasing the 2.0 version!
(And maybe catch a glimpse of some... familiar faces lurking in the dark... 👀)

notes.title: 🚨 Big Update - We're Back in Action! 🚨
notes.content:
[b]Preview of the 1.0 office from the Alpha Demo version:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147493/d319d03b4e776555fcad7ee1b52010ab9e96cea6.png[/img]

[b]Preview of the 2.0 office from the Early Access version:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147493/b973eb591855c16b864d3cc11b232bba93903f60.png[/img]

It’s been a while since we last updated you here on Steam, but we’ve been hard at work—and we’re finally back with some exciting news! Here’s what’s changed since our last update:

✅ [b]We've moved into Early Access (v2.0)[/b]
✅ A new [b]eerie atmosphere:[/b] subtle changes to keep you on edge
✅ Major updates to [b]game mechanics[/b] and [b]visuals[/b] for a smoother experience
✅ A [b]creepy phone system[/b] is now part of the game… yes, really.
✅ And yes, we’ve been improving everything, from the office to the gameplay.

We'll be rolling out detailed updates over the next few days, so stay tuned. Consider this post your "catch-up card" before we fully restart our devlog journey. And yes, expect sneak peeks into the game’s progress—video teasers are coming too 👀

🔧 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
More updates are coming soon, so don’t go too far. We can’t wait to show you the next steps as we keep pushing towards the final version.

Thank you for sticking with us! We couldn’t have done it without your support.

[b]Let's do this![/b] 🚀

notes.title: Nocturnal Nemesis is Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Nocturnal Nemesis[/b] is Now Live on Steam! 🥳


We are excited to announce that the [b]alpha demo[/b] for Nocturnal Nemesis is now officially available for download on Steam! Step into the darkness and face terrifying AI-driven threats as you navigate a creepy, abandoned setting. Will you survive the night?


👾 [b]What to Expect:[/b]

•  Intense first-person survival horror
•  Atmospheric tension and puzzles
•  Challenging enemies with advanced AI

Don't miss out on the action! Be sure to follow us on our YouTube and Discord for exclusive updates, gameplay videos, and to join our amazing community:

🔗 [b]YouTube:[/b] www.youtube.com/@mightymou
🔗 [b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.com/invite/HXbZdCxugh

We are excited to work with indie influencers and larger channels alike! If you’re interested in featuring Nocturnal Nemesis on your platform, don’t hesitate to get in touch. We are happy to collaborate and promote any creators who take our game behind the screen!

[i]Thank you all for your support, and we can't wait to see you in-game![/i]
